name: Memphis
summary: A place built as a tabletop model on warm white paper inside a grainy organic frame: flat Memphis colours, indigo ink outlines, hard cool-purple shadows filled with halftone dots, patterns instead of texture, and three quiet centred lines of type under the frame below three Memphis marks.

palette.use: the paper outside the frame; nothing else is drawn there except the type and marks
every outline, window frames, leader lines, section hatching
cobalt: blue light (450 nm), the zigzag mark, the emphasised word
the sun, the sunlight strip, yellow walls
the painted sky backdrop by day
the ground of the model (spring grass)
lighter lobes on the sun side of crowns
unlit windows at night; the night sky
lamp pools on the ground at night
the dusk layer on the way to night
the soil layer of the cut face (proposed)

type.case: sentence case; the data line in lower case
type.emphasis: cobalt on the emphasised word of line 1

banned: gradients anywhere: flat fills, patterns and hard shadows only
depth of field, reflections, bloom, motion blur or volumetric light
faceted shading or plastic highlights (that's low-poly); a cool diagram look (that's an isometric infographic)
characters acting: people are distant decoration only
colours sprinkled at random: cluster colour by area and leave large calm areas
grey nights or grey days; yellows going olive at night
identical trees: at least five crown shapes
outlines on thin things (stems, rods, light pools)
type over the picture or caption boxes: the three lines sit under the frame
a white flash, a spin or a fast hard cut
copying Memphis Group objects, layouts or palettes

sources.what: Lemo-Opuscar style No. 71 "Memphis Diorama" by @EianLu (STYLE.md, DEMO.md, frame and type constants in demo/memphis.js), via research notes
